hook: UTe2's metamagnetic transition appears to end at a quantum critical point near 75 tesla.

readout.label: Field of proposed quantum critical endpoint

summary: Magnetization and magnetostriction of the heavy-fermion material UTe2 in pulsed fields up to 60 T point to a quantum critical endpoint at about 70 degrees from the b axis and 75 T. A pseudo-gap in the susceptibility accompanies the transition. The endpoint lies beyond the measured field range and is extrapolated, and the link to field-induced superconductivity remains speculative.
title: Thermodynamic signatures of a nearby quantum critical endpoint in UTe$_2$ under intense magnetic field
